# authwise_access_role (Data Source)

A role in an audience's Access catalog. The id is the role's own name; its permissions are managed by `authwise_access_role_access_permissions`. This data source reads one by its full resource name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full resource name of the object to read.

### Read-Only

- `access_role_id` (String) Caller-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`.
- `audience_id` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `issuer_id` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String)
